name: notio
description: notio — клон Notion на Cloudflare Workers: микросервисы на Hono, database-per-service, realtime на Durable Objects

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n workers,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm run dev:workers" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.auth:schema: pnpm --dir services/auth-service exec better-auth generate --config src/auth/cli.config.ts --output src/db/auth-schema.generated.ts --yes
scripts.db:migrate:pages: wrangler d1 migrations apply notio-pages --local --persist-to .wrangler/state --config services/pages-service/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:auth: wrangler d1 migrations apply notio-auth --local --persist-to .wrangler/state --config services/auth-service/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:workspace: wrangler d1 migrations apply notio-workspace --local --persist-to .wrangler/state --config services/workspace-service/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm run db:migrate:pages && pnpm run db:migrate:auth && pnpm run db:migrate:workspace
